SIDEBAR.TITLE: Main Sidebar
SIDEBAR.DESCRIPTION: This is the main navigation sidebar. It gives you access to all areas of the dashboard. You can resize it by dragging the right edge, or collapse it to save space.

ACCOUNT_SWITCHER.TITLE: Account Switcher
ACCOUNT_SWITCHER.DESCRIPTION: Switch between different organizations or accounts. You can also create a new account from this menu.

SEARCH_BAR.TITLE: Search
SEARCH_BAR.DESCRIPTION: Quickly search across conversations, contacts, and more. You can also use the keyboard shortcut Cmd+K to open the search from anywhere.

COMPOSE_BUTTON.TITLE: New Conversation
COMPOSE_BUTTON.DESCRIPTION: Start a new conversation with a contact. Select the inbox and channel to begin a fresh chat.

NAV_INBOX.TITLE: My Inbox
NAV_INBOX.DESCRIPTION: Your personal notification inbox. See all the conversations and notifications assigned to you in one place.

NAV_CONVERSATIONS.TITLE: Conversations
NAV_CONVERSATIONS.DESCRIPTION: Access all your conversations. Filter by All, Mentions, Participating, Unattended, Folders, Teams, Channels, or Labels.

NAV_CONTACTS.TITLE: Contacts
NAV_CONTACTS.DESCRIPTION: Manage all your contacts. View, search, filter, and edit contact profiles with their conversation history.

NAV_REPORTS.TITLE: Reports
NAV_REPORTS.DESCRIPTION: View analytics and performance metrics. Track conversations, agent activity, CSAT scores, and more.

NAV_SETTINGS.TITLE: Settings
NAV_SETTINGS.DESCRIPTION: Configure your account, inboxes, agents, teams, automation, integrations, and all other settings.

PROFILE_MENU.TITLE: Profile Menu
PROFILE_MENU.DESCRIPTION: Access your profile settings, change appearance, view keyboard shortcuts, read documentation, or log out.

CHAT_LIST.TITLE: Chat List
CHAT_LIST.DESCRIPTION: This panel shows all your conversations. Click any conversation to open it. Conversations are sorted by most recent activity.

CHAT_LIST_HEADER.TITLE: Chat List Header
CHAT_LIST_HEADER.DESCRIPTION: See the total count of conversations and the current filter. Use the action buttons to manage your view.

FILTER_BUTTON.TITLE: Filters
FILTER_BUTTON.DESCRIPTION: Filter conversations by status, sort order, and more. Save your favorite filters as Folders for quick access.

CONVERSATION_BOX.TITLE: Conversation Area
CONVERSATION_BOX.DESCRIPTION: This is the main chat area where you read and reply to messages. The contact's messages appear on the left, your replies on the right.

REPLY_BOX.TITLE: Reply Box
REPLY_BOX.DESCRIPTION: Type your response here. You can use canned responses, attach files, insert emojis, and format your text. Press Enter to send.

CONTACT_SIDEBAR_TOGGLE.TITLE: Contact Panel
CONTACT_SIDEBAR_TOGGLE.DESCRIPTION: Toggle the contact information sidebar. View and edit contact details, attributes, labels, and conversation history.

CONTACTS_HEADER.TITLE: Contacts Page
CONTACTS_HEADER.DESCRIPTION: View and manage all your contacts. Search, filter, sort, and create new contacts from here.

CONTACTS_SEARCH.TITLE: Search Contacts
CONTACTS_SEARCH.DESCRIPTION: Search for contacts by name, email, phone number, or any custom attribute.

CONTACTS_LIST.TITLE: Contacts List
CONTACTS_LIST.DESCRIPTION: Browse your contacts. Click on any contact to view their full profile, conversations, and details.

CAMPAIGNS_WHATSAPP.TITLE: WhatsApp Campaigns
CAMPAIGNS_WHATSAPP.DESCRIPTION: Create and manage WhatsApp outreach campaigns sent directly through the WhatsApp integration.

CAMPAIGNS_BREVO.TITLE: Email Campaigns (Brevo)
CAMPAIGNS_BREVO.DESCRIPTION: Send bulk email campaigns using the Brevo integration. Track sends, opens, clicks and bounces.

CAMPAIGNS_META.TITLE: Meta Templates
CAMPAIGNS_META.DESCRIPTION: Manage your WhatsApp message templates approved via the Meta Graph API.

CAMPAIGNS_NEW.TITLE: New Campaign
CAMPAIGNS_NEW.DESCRIPTION: Click this button to start creating a new campaign on the current channel.

CAMPAIGNS_BREVO_NEW.TITLE: New Email Campaign
CAMPAIGNS_BREVO_NEW.DESCRIPTION: Create a new email campaign, choose your audience and connect your Brevo account.

CAMPAIGNS_META_NEW.TITLE: New Template
CAMPAIGNS_META_NEW.DESCRIPTION: Create a new WhatsApp message template to be submitted for Meta approval.

SETTINGS_HEADER.TITLE: Settings
SETTINGS_HEADER.DESCRIPTION: Configure every aspect of your Chatwoot account. Settings are organized in categories on the left.

SETTINGS_NAV.TITLE: Settings Navigation
SETTINGS_NAV.DESCRIPTION: Navigate between different settings sections: Account, Agents, Teams, Inboxes, Integrations, and more.

REPORTS_HEADER.TITLE: Reports Dashboard
REPORTS_HEADER.DESCRIPTION: Monitor your team's performance with detailed reports and analytics. Track response times, resolution rates, and customer satisfaction.
